name: nouveau-firmware
description: NVIDIA firmware blobs for the nouveau kernel driver (Ampere/RTX 30xx GA106 and related chips). Required for hardware acceleration before proprietary NVIDIA drivers are installed.

user: test -d linux-firmware/nvidia || { echo 'nouveau-firmware: nvidia tree missing in linux-firmware' >&2; exit 1; }
package: test -d $DESTDIR/usr/lib/firmware/nvidia/ga106 || test -d $DESTDIR/usr/lib/firmware/nvidia/ga102 || { echo 'nouveau-firmware: GA10x firmware missing' >&2; exit 1; }
find $DESTDIR/usr/lib/firmware/nvidia -type f | head -1 | grep -q . || { echo 'nouveau-firmware: no firmware files installed' >&2; exit 1; }

post_install: echo 'Installed NVIDIA firmware under /usr/lib/firmware/nvidia for nouveau.'
echo 'Reboot or reload nouveau after install: modprobe -r nouveau; modprobe nouveau'
